chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Fuḍayl narrated from al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a thief who entered upon a pregnant woman and killed what was in her womb. Then the woman took a knife and stabbed him with it, and she killed him.
He said: “The blood of the thief is void.”

key_terms.سِكِّينٍ: a knife used in the act of defense
key_terms.هَدَرَ دَمُ اللِّصِّ: the thief’s blood carries no liability or retaliation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman kills a thief who attacked her and caused the death of her unborn child?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a thief who assaults a pregnant woman and causes the death of the child in her womb. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام rules that when the woman kills him in response, the thief’s blood is without legal consequence.
